title: App Builder Review Verdict
description: Independent verdict on one artifact or stage. Creators never issue the final verdict on their own work.

authorRoles.description: Roles that created or materially changed the artifact. The reviewer must not appear here.

authorExecutor.description: What produced or materially changed the artifact, as distinct from the role it held. Principle 17 is enforced by role, and one model can hold two roles: asked to build and then to judge it agrees with itself while every role check passes. Optional, because most verdicts predate this field and a required one would invalidate them; absent means executor independence cannot be established, which is a finding rather than a pass.

attestedBy.description: runtime means the executor stamped its own identity from what it is. caller means somebody supplied it, and a reviewer identity supplied by the side being reviewed is a self-report.

reviewerExecutor.description: What issued this verdict. Optional for the same reason.

attestedBy.description: runtime means the executor stamped its own identity from what it is. caller means somebody supplied it, and a reviewer identity supplied by the side being reviewed is a self-report.

failingCriteria.description: Named criteria that failed. Required when the verdict is rework-required or blocked.

returnToRole.description: Creator role that owns the rework. Required when the verdict is rework-required.

blockedReason.description: Required when the verdict is blocked: what is missing outside the reviewer's control.
